description: This is a shell script for fixing prebuilt ELF check errors in Android.bp files by updating the 'shared_libs' fields. It provides usage instructions, handles command-line options, and manipulates Android.bp files using external tools like bpflatten and bpmodify.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: exit_handler
methods.description: Cleans up temporary files on script exit.

methods.name: trim_space
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: get_prop
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from MODULE_PROP_VALUES_DICT.

methods.name: rewrite_prop
methods.description: Rewrites a property in the Android.bp file using bpmodify.

methods.name: get_dt_needed
methods.description: Extracts the needed shared libraries from a binary using readelf.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique items from input.
